ModMetaData.name: French Grammar Plus (unofficial)
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
UNOFFICIAL. This mod is published without the original author's explicit consent. If the original author contacts me to request its removal, I undertake to take it down promptly.
Finishes the French grammar the game already does most of.
RimWorld 1.6 handles elision, contraction and plurals natively: le + voyelle becomes l', de le becomes du, a les becomes aux. This mod only covers what the engine still gets wrong.
RICH TEXT
The engine's elision rules stop at a markup tag. "de <color=#D09B61FF>Eclat</color>" stays "de Eclat" instead of "d'Eclat". The same rules are applied again here, this time reaching across the tag. Mods that colour their labels are the main beneficiaries.
ASPIRATED H
The engine treats every h as elidable, so it writes "l'haricot" and "d'hache". A word list marks the aspirated ones and they keep their article.
POSSESSIVES
"sa epee" becomes "son epee", as French requires before a vowel. The engine does not do this at all.
GRAMMATICAL GENDER OF SPECIES
A species noun has a gender of its own, unrelated to the sex of the animal wearing it: "la megaspider" is feminine even when the pawn is male. A word list gives each pawn kind its gender and the generated text follows it.
TYPOGRAPHY, OPTIONAL AND OFF BY DEFAULT
Non-breaking spaces before : ; ! and ?. Left off because it depends on the font having those characters.
Both word lists are plain text files in the mod's Data folder. Edit them without recompiling, and send additions upstream.
CREDITS
The elision and plural rules that are now vanilla were written by Adirelle and b606 for the LanguageWorker_French mod and later adopted by Ludeon. This mod deliberately does not reimplement them. Its aspirated-h word list was rebuilt from standard French rather than copied.
No save data. Can be added to or removed from an ongoing game.
